headline_title: Mar 2026: NZ$79,200 revenue on 433 orders, average order value NZ$182.91
trend_title: Revenue up 55.6% on February after the 42.5% February fall
trend_qty_title: Units up 40.57% to 2,467 after February's 25.98% decline
structure_intro_title: Premium lines account for NZ$35,255, or 44.5% of store revenue
category_mix_title: Supplements lead on revenue at 31.1%; souvenirs 16.9% of revenue on 24.6% of units
premium_mix_title: Souvenirs 37.9% and honey 30.0% of premium revenue; milk powder 4.8%
top_products_title: Six of the top ten SKUs are premium, led by souvenirs and supplements
brand_title: Ambervale at 8.2% of store revenue heads the top five
milk_brand_title: Ambervale and Clearfield together hold over half of milk powder revenue
milk_brand_note: Ambervale takes 29.3% of milk powder revenue and Clearfield 24.7%, with Fernvale lowest of the six listed at 8.9%. The gap between the top two and Highmoor at 15.6% shows where the category's volume sits.
pickup_title: Pickup regular revenue NZ$10,231 in March against premium NZ$1,676
pickup_comment: Regular pickup revenue rose to NZ$10,231.29 from NZ$7,153.60 in February, while premium pickup fell across both February and March to NZ$1,675.84 on 25 units. Premium lines could be given counter space at the pickup point so collection customers see them at the moment of handover.
functional_title: Probiotic and lecithin lead March functional revenue; propolis at NZ$466
functional_note: Probiotic reached NZ$3,733.39 in March from NZ$1,051.38 in February, and lecithin NZ$2,713.44 from NZ$629.43, while propolis fell in both February and March to NZ$465.89. Fish oil held the largest single line at NZ$4,270.25.
channel_title: Export units back to 1,230 in March, close to local at 1,240
channel_comment: Export units fell 40.0% in February and rose 62.06% in March, a pattern typically affected by Chinese New Year, when cross-border freight and clearance are suspended. Local units rose 24.0% to 1,240, leaving the split at 50.2% local to 49.8% export.
concentration_title: Top SKU decile carries 32.6% of revenue; half the range covers 82.8%
operations_title: 231 visits and 88 mini-programme leads at a 59.0% completion rate
campaign_title: March activity centred on premium supplements
